shortDescription: UPESSC has declared the UPTET 2026 result and released the eligibility certificate. Candidates can check the result and download the certificate from the official portal.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has declared the UPTET 2026 Result and released the associated certificate for eligible candidates.

The official result and certificate links are available on the UPESSC portal for Primary and Junior Level candidates.

Important dates

  • Application begin: 27 March 2026
  • Last date for registration: 03 May 2026
  • Pay exam fee last date: 03 May 2026
  • Last date correction: 08 May 2026
  • Exam date: 02-04 July 2026
  • Exam city: 22 June 2026
  • Admit card: 30 June 2026
  • Answer key: 08 July 2026
  • Result declared: 26 August 2026
  • Certificate released: 07 September 2026

Eligibility

UPTET eligibility varies for Primary and Junior Level. Candidates should read the official notification and NCTE norms for Bachelor / Master / B.Ed / BTC / B.ElEd / B.Sc.Ed requirements and other academic details.

How to check result

Open the official UPTET result portal, enter the required credentials, submit the form and download the result. For certificates, open the certificate portal and download the official certificate after result declaration.
